CONTENT NOTICE:  This is not necessarily a game for kids!  It features graphic violence, including decapitation and dismemberment, and
is much like an action movie that is rated R for "Restricted."  It also has profanity in it, and although there are no
"sex scenes" in it whatsoever, or pictures or depictions of any sexual body parts at all whatsoever, the main characters in the game
talk about things they wouldn't necessarily talk about in front of mature adults, especially their parents.
They also curse and swear sometimes, and in the in-game conversations they WILL talk about things they do with each other and stuff
that isn't exactly "family friendly."  If you're a kid who can't watch R-rated movies, then your parents probably don't want you
playing this game, FYI.  On the other hand, if you're used to R-rated action flicks where the characters use four-letter words,
have blood and guts on-screen sometimes, and sometimes mention specific body parts by name, you should be fine playing this.
There's no use hiding it, the main protagonist and his friends do use teenage / young adult slang words and phrases, some of it clean,
some of it not.  As a rule, however, none of it is racist.  If this makes you squeamish, then don't play the game, and go ahead and click
on the "x" in the corner of the window if you are playing on Microsoft Windows to close the game if you really want to.
This game, though made with RPG Maker MZ, DOES try to do things a little "new and different" to make it stand out.  It is a little,
uh, "non-standard" shall we say, ON PURPOSE.
The game tries to introduce you to how it can be very early in gameplay, to let you decide.
You can play this game with a four-button USB game controller, a mouse and a keyboard, or just a keyboard.  It is supposed to also work with
a touch display on a smartphone if enabled in the options, but the developer hasn't tested that.
Press F4 during gameplay (including now, if desired) to toggle full-screen vs windowed, and the X in the window corner closes the game.
You'll need to choose a name for the main character, a 22 year old human boy who is born half-dragon.  His half-dragon magical nature gives him super-fast
reflexes and muscular strength, both of which surpass what the best athletic humans could hope to have.  This magical dual-nature also includes firebreathing,
near-total immunity to fire, extreme cold, and electrical attacks, and partial immunity to poison and wind-based attacks.  He is also faster in combat than
any pure-blood human.  Because of his speed, he can act many times every combat turn.
Note that when decapitated, this doesn't kill him, and you control his headless body.  This doesn't kill his head either.  This is
because he is a magical creature who is half-human and half-dragon.  He can still breathe fire when his head is chopped off, by
holding his head to aim the flames.  Note that even if his head is still with him, and not lost or left somewhere, he suffers
penalties to combat speed and other combat-related skills and stats, including how many times he can act in a combat turn.
He can also voluntarily cut his own head off, which has uses and solves certain puzzles in the game.  Being half-dragon, he
can re-attach severed body parts and regrow missing ones, which allows him to heal Hit Points of damage, among other things.
Note that with his superior speed and non-human (over)confidence, sometimes he gets reckless in combat and parts of him get
severed.  His companions are more careful though, so they don't suffer what he can handle easily.
He is also immune to feeling pain.  His half-dragon brain, nerves, and neurons completely lack any pain sensation sensing or
transmitting.  He is born this way, born half-dragon.
More about his dragon side, and what type of dragon it is, is detailed throughout the game.

\P[1] is a swordfighter and master of 2-handed swords.  He specializes in 2-handed greatswords built and designed for half-dragons.
He can excel at being a swordsman of 2-handed swords, or he can be a combination of a swordsman and another character class at the
same time.  The choice is yours, and your choice will determine abilities and such for him for the entire playthrough.  It cannot
be changed later.  Pick a class or class combination now, please.  (This is the first choice of six people.)
The other five party members, his companions, include his girlfriend and four close friends of his, four college boys he
knows from school (college).  All four boys are pure-blooded common humans, and his girlfriend is also a half dragon.  All five can be one
of six character classes: Axe Master, Mage, Witch, Wizard, Ranger, or Thief.  All have class-specific weapons and gear, and specific
guns as well as other things as backup weapons.  Dual-class options are also available.
Note that \P[1]'s five friends won't have stats or abilities that are exactly the same, so if you
assign two of them to the same class, you can expect them to have slightly different ability scores, maximum Hit Points,
Experience Point gain rates, etc., as some people are more athletic than others, and some people are smarter and better
at certain things in school than others.  \P[1]'s friends are not clones!

Aside from the information already given at the start of the game, \P[1] is a half-dragon, half-human sixteen-year-old teenage boy from Acrydia.
His dragon half is of a type of dragon called a zarakite, as opposed to other types of dragons.  Zarakites are dragons that look much like skinny
humans.  Their skin tone varies in color, ranging from darker tones to caucasian colors, and then pure white, which is literally as white as fresh

This game is easily played with a USB game controller, with at least four regular buttons, A, B, X, and Y.  Types that have two sticks and

toggles between playing the game in a window and playing full-screen, where the game automatically zooms and rescales it's display.  When the
game is in windowed mode, clicking the usual "x" button in the corner of the window's top upper right will close the game.
You can also use a standard USB keyboard and mouse of nearly any sort, or just the keyboard by itself if you desire.
The game, with RPG Maker default settings, can also be configured (the Settings Menu, from the Main Menu when you start the game) to accept touch-screen input, for
example if you are playing the game on a smartphone.  The developer of this game hasn't tested this, and doesn't know the details, but you can probably
The game's start-up Main Title Menu also has some options, in it's Option's Menu, for changing the volume of music and sound fx.
These are generated by RPG Maker MZ software, not the developer of this game.  BGM probably stands for Background Music, SE likely stands for
Sound Effects (volume), and I'm not sure what BGS and ME stand for, but ME volume controls short music clips, and BGS affects background
looping sound effects, such as background conversation noise in a coffee shop or something.
The game's display is designed to work with 1920x1080 resolution displays and above.  It should work fine with 2K and 4K displays and so on.
It also should work fine with high refresh rate displays without issues.
The game can be unpacked and ran directly from a USB stick or 'flash drive,' also known as a 'jump drive.'  It might run slower when you
do this, though.  Burning the game to DVD and running it directly from a DVD hasn't been tested, although saving and loading games might not
work if you do this (and probably won't).

that the game is freeware, if you have a website you ARE allowed to host this game on it, if you want.  It is still protected by Copyright if
you do this, and putting it on your website doesn't mean you own it, thank you, but you have permission to do this.

You'll need to choose a name for the main character, a teenage human boy who is born half-dragon.  His half-dragon magical nature gives him super-fast reflexes
and muscular strength, both of which surpass what the best athletic humans could hope to have.  This magical dual-nature also includes
firebreathing, near-total immunity to fire, extreme cold, and electrical attacks, and partial immunity to poison and wind-based attacks.  He is
also faster in combat than any pure-blood human.  Because of his speed, he can act many times every combat turn.
Note that when decapitated, this doesn't kill him, and you control his headless body.  This doesn't kill his head either.  This is
because he is a magical creature who is half-human and half-dragon.  He can still breathe fire when his head is chopped off, by
holding his head to aim the flames.  Note that even if his head is still with him, and not lost or left somewhere, he suffers
penalties to combat speed and other combat-related skills and stats, including how many times he can act in a combat turn.
He can also voluntarily cut his own head off, which has uses and solves certain puzzles in the game.  Being half-dragon, he
can re-attach severed body parts and regrow missing ones, which allows him to heal Hit Points of damage, among other things.
Note that with his superior speed and non-human (over)confidence, sometimes he gets reckless in combat and parts of him get
severed.  His companions are more careful though, so they don't suffer what he can handle easily.
He is also immune to feeling pain.  His half-dragon brain, nerves, and neurons completely lack any pain sensation sensing or
transmitting.  He is born this way, born half-dragon.
More about his dragon side, and what type of dragon it is, is detailed throughout the game.
